title: Generalizations of the Squircle-Lemniscate Relation and Keplerian Dynamics
summary: This paper establishes a generalized relationship between the arc length of sinusoidal spirals \(r^n=\cos(nθ)\) and the area of generalized Lamé curves defined by \(x^{2n}+y^{2n}=1\). Building on our previous work connecting the lemniscate to the squircle, we prove an integral identity relating these two curves for any positive integer $n$, which we further generalize to arbitrary positive real exponents and general superellipses.
